title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
summary: Set in the fictional Mississippi River town of St. Petersburg, Missouri, this novel follows the mischievous, imaginative boy Tom Sawyer through a series of boyhood escapades. Tom lives with his stern but loving Aunt Polly and half-brother Sid, dodges chores (famously tricking friends into whitewashing a fence for him), and courts Becky Thatcher. With his friend Huckleberry Finn, the town's outcast boy, Tom witnesses a murder committed by the sinister Injun Joe in a graveyard, runs away to become a pirate on Jackson's Island, and returns to attend his own funeral. Later adventures include testifying at a murder trial, getting lost with Becky in a labyrinthine cave where they encounter Injun Joe again, and discovering a cache of buried treasure. The book closes with Huck being taken in by the Widow Douglas and reluctantly submitting to civilized life, persuaded by Tom's promise of forming a robber gang. Blending nostalgia, humor, and adventure, the novel offers a vivid, affectionate portrait of American boyhood, superstition, and small-town life along the river in the mid-19th century.
